__purpose: Manager node spec for editable integer numeric constants.
label: Int

metadata.description: Produces a whole-number value from config or a connected numeric input.

compatibility.rule: Use Int for index, range, counts, and other discrete numeric controls.
compatibility.repairHint: Use Float when fractional values are required.

examples.title: Index value
examples.summary: Set value=1 to drive a downstream Index or Range input.

repairHints: Int rounds incoming numeric input to the nearest whole number.
